reason: Intentional breaking change: SubgraphResult is keyed by (kind, id) instead of node id, so two same-id nodes of different kinds can both be returned. The id-keyed adjacency/reverseAdjacency maps are replaced by edges plus node/outgoing/incoming (kind, id) lookups. SubgraphResult is produced by TypeGraph, not authored by consumers; listed under Breaking in the changeset.
